evals.name: yaml-form-contract-no-invented-checks
evals.prompt: 帮我整理一个 skill 偶发不触发的 Bug issue。用仓库 YAML 表单；我还没有稳定复现，也没提供客户端版本。先不要创建。
evals.expected_output: Uses the bug form's title prefix, labels, headings, and dropdown options; asks only for material missing facts and never fabricates reproduction or environment details.
expectations: Reads issue forms and config.yml before drafting
Renders form input labels as Markdown headings in field order
Does not check unsupported checklist items or invent version/log facts
Separates author-facing questions from the issue body and performs no writes

evals.name: discussion-vs-feature-and-label-mismatch
evals.prompt: 我们还没决定是合并两个 skills 还是拆分触发边界，帮我写 issue。表单里的默认 label 在远端不存在。
evals.expected_output: Selects the discussion/proposal form for an unresolved decision and reports the label mismatch without creating or substituting labels automatically.
expectations: Does not present the unresolved design as an approved feature implementation
Follows the selected form's title prefix and fields
Asks before creating or substituting a missing label
Does not bypass disabled blank issues with a generic body

evals.name: duplicate-tracking-issue-confirmation
evals.prompt: 这个模板维护需求帮我落成 issue；如果已有长期 issue 能覆盖，先告诉我，不要重复创建。
evals.expected_output: Searches concrete behavior and scope, presents a candidate tracking issue for confirmation, and does not create or associate anything automatically.
expectations: Searches existing issues before offering creation
Shows candidate scope and number; similarity alone does not authorize reuse
Keeps umbrella or partial delivery non-closing
Creation requires approval of the complete title/body/repository/labels draft
